scripts.migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute bookrecs-db --remote --yes --file scripts/adopt-d1-migrations.sql && wrangler d1 migrations apply bookrecs-db --remote
scripts.preview: bun run build && bun run migrate:local && wrangler pages dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy web/dist --project-name=bookrecs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.bun.json && bun run --cwd web typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run knip && bun run test
